title: Authors Equity (publisher) on Incorruptible's NYT debut — 'Eric spent years figuring out why that happens, and more importantly, how to stop it'
summary: Authors Equity — Incorruptible's publisher — marks the book's New York Times Bestseller debut with an institutional congratulations post framing the book as the antidote to the system that pulls beloved companies off mission.
blockquote:
Eric Ries's INCORRUPTIBLE debuted on the New York Times list this week, and we couldn't be prouder.

Most of us have watched a company we loved lose its way. Not because the people inside stopped caring, but because the system pulled it there. Eric spent years figuring out why that happens, and more importantly, how to stop it.

We're so glad the world is starting to find this book.
